text:
evan: Release window tonight 20:00 UTC for SDK publishes. Targeting python package v1.8.0 and JS package v2.1.0. Plan: canary -> monitor -> promote to stable after ~2h. Pin strategy: examples should pin major.minor, allow patch updates. We will deprecate legacy sync client in this release. Need quick go/no-go and any blockers.
maya: Docs PR #912 is ready to merge once release goes. +1
sam: CI failing one ts-sdk e2e test (rate limiter). seeing `Error: Timeout waiting for token bucket refill` in tests/ratelimit.test.ts:42. Might be a flaky timing issue.
ci-bot: CI: failing job ts-sdk-e2e (flake) — rerun requested by sam
paula: We need deprecation text and a migration example in the release notes. I can add it if someone approves the wording.
evan: Sam — can you paste the failing log and whether it's reproducible locally? If it's a flake we can rerun; if deterministic we should hold.
sam: Repro once on my laptop. Pasting snippet: `Error: Timeout waiting for token bucket refill\n at tests/ratelimit.test.ts:42:17`. Investigating now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled sdk-canary-publish at 1763808000 (20:00 UTC) pending manual trigger
maya: If sam is still debugging at 19:30 UTC let's hold — don't want to push a broken client to users.
evan: OK setting a soft hold. I'll pin canary to `next` but not promote until we confirm. Rollback plan: remove npm dist-tag, yank pypi release if necessary, alert customers via /announce. Also have rollback playbook steps in the release doc.
paula: Docs PR #912 link: https://gh/redwood/PR/912 — migration example included: `from redwood import AsyncClient` -> `from redwood import Client` and migration note for sync->async.
sam: Found cause — flaky timing. Bumping sleep from 20ms -> 50ms in tests fixes it. Pushing fix to branch `ts/fix-rate-flake`.
evan: Hold release until that fix lands and CI is green. Deploy window stays at 20:00 UTC but manual trigger only. @deploy-bot please cancel scheduled job for now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canceled scheduled job sdk-canary-publish (requested by evan)
maya: :thumbsup: thanks, reopen when ready.
evan: After merge we'll follow the checklist: 1) publish canary (npm publish --tag next; twine upload to pypi rc) 2) wait ~2h for telemetry 3) promote (npm dist-tag add @redwood-sdk@2.1.0 stable; release wheels to pypi final) 4) cut release note including deprecation and migration snippets 5) announce. Rollback steps are in the release playbook.
ci-bot: CI: rerun passed on branch ts/fix-rate-flake — all green
sam: merging now
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: manual trigger available at https://deploy/redwood/sdk/publish (authorized: evan, maya, paula)
evan: Triggering now. ETA ~10m, I'll watch logs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary publish started at 1763801860
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: npm publish completed (tag=next) — redwood-sdk-js@2.1.0-canary.1
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pypi upload completed — redwood-python v1.8.0rc1
maya: monitoring telemetry dashboard, looks stable so far :eyes:
evan: If we see no regressions in ~2h we'll promote to stable and push final release notes and deprecation notices. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
